title: Additional Fusion Attachments
description: The &3Fusion Reactor Breeding Chamber&r uses neutron flux from a torus to in order to process materials. It can perform any recipe from an &3RBMK irradiation channel&r, with some additional recipes aswell. The neutron flux is not affected by port sharing rules, and the output level is the same on any side.
The &3Fusion Reactor Collection Chamber&r increases the byproduct production rate by &e50%&r.
